content.title: Vaccine Stocks Fall Following Report of Plans to Link Covid Shot With Child Deaths
content.summary: Shares of vaccine companies fell after a report that federal officials plan to link Covid-19 vaccines with child deaths.  Pfizer shares declined 4%, Novavax shares fell 3.6%, Moderna shares were down 7.4% and BioNTech shares closed 7.3% lower.  The Washington Post reported Friday that federal health officials plan to link the vaccines to the deaths of 25 children during a presentation next week to advisers to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
